name: luxenx-monorepo
description: LuxenX — monorepo : applications Windows LuxenX et LuxenX Admin, backend Node.js, packages partagés.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace packages/shared --workspace packages/validation --workspace packages/api-client --workspace packages/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:packages && npm run dist:desktop && npm run dist:admin
scripts.test:tools: node tests/tools/env-file.test.mjs && node tests/tools/notes-check.test.mjs && node tests/tools/next-free-version.test.mjs
